\[Q = \frac{rs}{t} + \frac{st}{r} + \frac{tr}{s}.\]

\[\frac{rs}{t} + \frac{st}{r} + \frac{tr}{s} = \frac{rs \cdot rs + st \cdot tr + tr \cdot rt}{rst} = \frac{r^2s^2 + t^2r^2 + r^2s^2}{rst} = \frac{2r^2s^2 + r^2s^2 + t^2r^2 + r^2s^2}{rst}.\]

\[\frac{rs}{t} + \frac{st}{r} + \frac{tr}{s} = \frac{13}{3}.\]
